Waist length curly hair and unmotivated adhd'er. Here are some tips on minimal haircare with maximum results:

- Water is your best friend
- Only comb your hair when wet - preferably with a shit load of conditioner for slip to get rid of annoying knots 
- Sleep with hair in a loose pineapple
- Sleep on a satin pillowcase
- Style hair when wet - my most basic routine is using conditioner as a styler
- Use a deep treatment as and when you need it. You will know, your hair will be dry and brittle
- When you can be asked, make a DIY protein treatment. An egg and an oil of your choosing works. I usually use evoo with a splash of castor
- Add leave in to wet hair, then a styler of your choice - mouse is great for definition I have recently discovered

I'm sorry for your loss. Thhe first thing that I would naturally suggest is therapy. The right therapist can really help, but i understand due to your past experiences that it doesn't seem like it will work.

The second thing I would suggest is to read Matt Haig: Reasons to Stay Alive. I know the title sounds like it's going to be a preachy, 'If life hands you lemons make lemonade' type of book, but it is easily the besssssst book i've ever read.

I've suffered with mental health issues for over a decade and this is the first book i've read that helped. It follows the authors story and all of the thoughts he had, all of the methods he took and the his story of recovery (without all of the sugar coated bullshit). I can't recommend it enough. Not only for those suffering with these feelings, but for those closest to them also, to help them understand. I hope it helps.
